architecture.terrain_authority: The existing 1009x1009 reach-local Landscape remains the sole terrain rendering, collision, and height-query authority.
architecture.water_authority: The existing live cooked-field water remains the sole gameplay water rendering and raft-force authority; capture-only ribbon and foam actors remain hidden in play.
architecture.morphology_change: Each former single rainforest ellipsoid is replaced by one higher-resolution opaque core and six smaller deterministically rotated and tilted crownlets. The same four non-colliding HISM families and the same source-mask, slope-screened instance placement remain in use.
architecture.material_change: The Pacuare-only opaque vegetation material shadow-fill factor rises from 0.145 to 0.20 and its deterministic per-instance energy range widens from 0.86-1.14 to 0.84-1.16.
architecture.claims_boundary: The V2 meshes are project-owned deterministic presentation fallback geometry. They make no exact Pacuare species, ecology, season, survey, hydraulic, bathymetry, wind, or raft-force claim.

matched_capture_metrics.scope: Two fixed canopy-bank rectangles per 1280x720 camera: x 0-499 and 780-1279, y 0-399.
matched_capture_metrics.green_dominant_definition: G > 1.16*R, G > 1.04*B, and G > 0.075 in normalized sRGB.
matched_capture_metrics.orientation_entropy_definition: Normalized Shannon entropy of 18 unsigned gradient-orientation bins for green pixels whose neighboring-luma gradient exceeds 0.025; higher values mean less concentration in a few repeated edge directions.
matched_capture_metrics.verdict: Retain as a bounded morphology and readability improvement. Both views gain materially more crown-edge structure, slightly higher gradient-orientation entropy, and lower near-black coverage. Green-dominant area falls because the smaller crownlets expose more branch and bank structure. The result remains visibly procedural and is not a photoreal pass.

validation.filtered_regeneration: pacuare completed successfully with the same saved instance counts
validation.visual_gate: matched fixed guide-seat and river-eye evidence retained as a technical improvement

remaining_photoreal_defects: The V2 crowns still read as repeated procedural clusters rather than scanned or species-authentic tropical foliage, and the exposed trunks and branch junctions remain uniform.
A four-mesh family cannot represent Pacuare canopy strata, age classes, palms, vines, epiphytes, roots, deadwood, rainforest-floor diversity, wind, wetness, or season.
The 30 m source context and bounded procedural bank relief still produce broad smooth landforms without surveyed bank breaklines or production wet-bank microgeometry.
Water remains optically thin with weak rapid foam, breaking-wave volume, spray, mist, rock-contact plumes, reflection, refraction, caustics, and riverbed transitions.
Cooked hydraulics remain unconverged and discharge, bathymetry, stationing, hazards, and guide line are not calibrated to observed Upper Huacas behavior.
The corridor still lacks reviewed rainforest atmosphere, volumetric humidity, distance haze, production color grading, and target-hardware performance evidence.
required_external_acceptance_gates: Pacuare guide review of the Upper Huacas line, hazards, water levels, entry, exit, and rescue routes
geospatial review of exact stationing, planform, vertical datum, bank breaklines, higher-resolution terrain, rocks, and bathymetry
hydraulic calibration and convergence approval against observed Upper Huacas behavior across playable flow bands
ecology and environment-art approval of species, density, canopy strata, ground cover, geology, wet banks, lighting, and rainforest atmosphere
photoreal water/VFX plus raft, equipment, character, animation, and occlusion approval
desktop and VR target-hardware performance, collision, capsize, recovery, and complete-run gameplay acceptance
